2608.15071.title: Evo-Harness: Context-to-Harness Skill Compilation for Self-Evolving Agents
2608.15071.paper_summary: Learning from experience is critical for developing capable, self-improving large language model (LLM) agents. Existing methods typically extract knowledge from accumulated trajectories via reflection, memory, rules, or skills. However, agents in realistic environments continuously encounter novel tasks, often offering only a one-shot opportunity to improve. These executions yield rich but highly noisy contexts, entangling broadly useful lessons with task-specific artifacts. Critically, prior works rarely validate their effectiveness on complex real-world tasks or isolate the underlying drivers of improvement. To address these gaps, we formulate online harness learning, where a frozen agent improves by continually updating a structured harness across sequential tasks. This formulation enables a systematic study of key self-improvement factors through our proposed Evo-Harness. At its core, context-to-harness skill compilation distills noisy, single-shot executions into reusable skill harnesses for cross-domain and topic-level adaptation. To demonstrate the efficacy of one-shot skill compilation, we evaluate across five realistic benchmarks (TerminalBench2, SWE-bench, CL-Bench, -bench, WebArena-Infinity). Our extensive analysis demonstrates the effectiveness of Evo-Harness and provides a principled understanding of how LLM agents can effectively learn on the fly. Our code is available at https://github.com/A-EVO-Lab/a-evolve/tree/release/evo-harness.
2608.15071.paper_summary_zh: 學習經驗對於發展有能力、自我改善的大型語言模型（LLM）代理至關重要。現有的方法通常通過反思、記憶、規則或技能從累積的軌跡中提取知識。然而，現實環境中的代理不斷遇到新任務，通常只提供一次性改善的機會。這些執行產生了豐富但高度嘈雜的上下文，將廣泛有用的教訓與特定任務的工件交織在一起。關鍵是，先前的研究很少在複雜的現實世界任務上驗證其有效性或隔離改善的根本驅動因素。為了解決這些空白，我們提出了在線鞍座學習的概念，其中一個靜態代理通過不斷更新結構化鞍座來改善其在連續任務中的表現。這一公式使我們能夠通過我們提出的Evo-Harness系統地研究關鍵的自我改善因素。其核心是，從上下文到鞍座的技能編譯將嘈雜的單次執行提煉為可重用的技能鞍座，以便進行跨領域和主題級別的適應。為了展示一次性技能編譯的有效性，我們在五個現實基準（TerminalBench2、SWE-bench、CL-Bench、-bench、WebArena-Infinity）上進行了評估。我們的廣泛分析展示了Evo-Harness的有效性，並提供了對LLM代理如何能夠有效即時學習的原則性理解。我們的代碼可在https://github.com/A-EVO-Lab/a-evolve/tree/release/evo-harness獲得。
